cohort: The study included 64 healthy women with term, uncomplicated pregnancies undergoing elective cesarean section.
finding: Over 50% of maternal peripheral blood and umbilical cord blood samples showed detectable S. mutans DNA, which positively correlated with S. mutans detection in maternal saliva and was often associated with frequent tooth brushing.
cross-section timing: Peripartum (on the day of hospitalization and after delivery)
